resources.string: Scrolls the page you\'re reading so you don\'t have to keep swiping. It can\'t see what\'s on your screen, and it never uses the internet.
Tap Start to scroll the page you\'re reading.
Scrolling. Touch the screen or tap Stop to stop.
Proximity control — cover the top of the phone to start or stop
This device has no proximity sensor.
Steady Read needs this permission to scroll the screen for you. It can\'t see what\'s on your screen, and it never uses the internet.
Once it\'s on, start and stop scrolling from the notifications drawer at the top of the screen. You can also stop it any time by touching the screen.
